output.sql:
SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01' THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_2024,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_2025,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' THEN l.net_amount ELSE -l.net_amount END), 2) AS revenue_increase
FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue_increase DESC
LIMIT 1
output.explanation: This sums line-level net amounts by product category for revenue orders only (is_revenue), for calendar years 2024 and 2025 by order date. It returns the category with the largest absolute change (2025 minus 2024), along with both years' revenue. Amounts are assumed to be in EUR. If the result is negative, no category grew.
